summary: SiteDocument represents a document entity linked to a site in the HSPnet system. It is primarily used for storing IDs related to the site and the document.
purpose: To maintain references between a document and its associated site for further operations or retrieval within the HSPnet Data Layer.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is an ASP.NET page for staff administrators, providing a dashboard with login information and search/filter controls for employment applications. It supports workflow controls for filtering by site, discipline, and date, and provides validation and UI elements for error/warning handling.
purpose: To enable staff administrators to view and filter employment applications, display last login info, and manage error/warning messages within a structured web UI.

fields.name: txtStartDate
fields.description: Start date for filtering employment applications.

fields.name: txtEndDate
fields.description: End date for filtering employment applications.

workflows.name: View and Filter Employment Applications
steps: Select site, discipline, and date range filters
Press refresh to update the employment applications grid

business_rules: Show only applications within selected date range.
Include withdrawn applications based on checkbox.
validations: CustomValidator to ensure StartDate is before EndDate.
conditions: If no last login info, do not show last login panel.
system_behavior: Error and warning panels display messages.

summary: ServiceCode represents a code used to categorize services in the HSPnet system. ServiceCodes provides methods to retrieve lists of codes based on various criteria (all, by course, by timetable).
purpose: To categorize and manage codes and descriptions for services, supporting localization and various retrieval options in the application.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Additional notes about the service code.

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID for filtered lists.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is set, use alternative descriptions and notes.
system_behavior: List retrieval is governed by stored procedure calls.
Localization is supported based on session language settings.

summary: SiteProfileHistory logs changes made to a site profile, tracking actions, users, fields changed, and agency information. The related methods support searching history and populating from database sources for user interface display.
purpose: To provide detailed audit logs of site profile changes for transparency, accountability, and rollback purposes in the HSPnet system.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the history entry.

fields.name: LastName
fields.description: Last name of the responsible user.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.description: First name of the responsible user.

fields.name: MiddleName
fields.description: Middle name of the responsible user.

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: User ID who performed the action.

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Was the action performed by a system administrator?

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is set, use alternative language fields for screen section, user action, and fields.
User audit formatting differs if performed by sysadmin or original user.
conditions: If system administrator performs the action, special formatting applies.
system_behavior: UI display binds data source appropriately.

summary: EmailPopupDocument models a file for email popup interactions, including filename, path, and a selection flag. EmailPopupDocuments provides methods to search for and delete documents, handling file and directory operations.
purpose: To support file management and popup selection/deletion for email attachments or related documents in HSPnet, including safe file and directory deletions.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the document in the popup.

fields.name: Checked
fields.description: Boolean flag indicating if document is selected.

workflows.name: Search and Delete Email Popup Documents
steps: Delete document (and directory) for a given ID when requested

business_rules: If DataInfo is empty, do not return documents.
Safe deletion (try-catch for file and directory removal).
conditions: If emailData.Length == 2, document is valid and added.
system_behavior: Parsing of DataInfo for document list.
